notes.title: X2 Bonus Pack 1.04 and new languages available
notes.content:
This update brings the Bonus Pack from version 1.03 to 1.04, which was previously only available as a non-Steam version. On Steam the Bonus Pack for X2 is already included in the base game. For more information on the Bonus Pack and the changes, see [url=http://forum.egosoft.com/viewtopic.php?t=55445]this forum thread[/url].

At the same time, we have made the following localisations available:
[list][*]Russian (full audio)
[*]Czech (text/subtitles)
[*]Polish (text/subtitles)[/list]
